assessments.reasoning: The six verified publisher ranges identify which form is being licensed and whose rights are protected. The conjunction joining the two limbs of section 3.2 preserves the access duty when the distributor exercises the sublicensing permission.

limitations: Section 3.2(a) continues to require covered-source availability and instructions under either executable licensing choice.
reasoning: Section 3.2(b) permits MPL terms for the covered executable or a sublicense on different terms. The condition addresses even an attempt by the executable license to alter or limit recipients’ MPL rights in the source.
